final_rationale: The verdict remains suspicious because the Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence and instead offered a narrower interpretation of the same evidence. That reframing is more disciplined than the original broad compliance claim, but it does not cure the missing support link. A caveated-compliance finding would be appropriate only if the remaining caveat were a bounded residual risk after the relevant compliance predicate had been satisfied or shown inapplicable. Here, the unresolved issue is itself the predicate: whether a material weakness affecting a named use case required disclosure or approved risk acceptance before certification. On the current admissible record, that question is still open. Because the concern is unresolved rather than merely residual, the narrowed position is still not supported to a compliant or compliant_with_caveats standard.
